description: This file contains integration tests for the PersonController in a Spring Boot application, verifying CRUD operations, pagination, validation, and conflict handling.

classes.name: PersonControllerIntegrationTest
classes.description: Integration test class for the PersonController, testing CRUD operations, validations, and error handling.

methods.name: create_get_update_delete_flow
methods.description: Tests the full lifecycle of creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting a person, including verifying proper response structures and status codes.

methods.name: list_is_paginated_and_wrapped
methods.description: Verifies that the list endpoint returns paginated results wrapped in a standard response envelope.

methods.name: validation_errors_are_wrapped
methods.description: Checks that validation errors produce the correct wrapped error response with field-specific error details.

methods.name: duplicate_email_is_conflict_and_wrapped
methods.description: Ensures attempting to create a person with a duplicate email results in a conflict status and an appropriate wrapped error response.
